name: Information loss

subjectOf.text: Because human interactions in business are often too complex to be fully codified objectively, DeFi systems that exclude all non objective information from their analysis do not fully utilize available information, which limits their efficiency and usefulness.
subjectOf.abstract: However, human interaction in business are often too complex to be fully codified objectively. By excluding all non- objective information from the product analysis, all available information may not be fully utilized which limits efficiency and potential usefulness of DeFi
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Digital Asset Market Evolution (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3606663
scope_conditions: DeFi products analyzing only objectively recordable and verifiable inputs

subjectOf.text: Because information at the edge does not travel up a centralized hierarchy, the central authority makes decisions without full information, and a centralized organization is therefore not well designed to respond to any crisis it has not anticipated.
subjectOf.abstract: The central authority makes decisions without full information, so a central- ized organization is not well designed to respond to any crisis it hasn't anticipated.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Introduction to Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782192
scope_conditions: strongly centralized organizations that leave no decision power at the edges

subjectOf.text: GNN scalability on large real world graphs is a genuine trade off rather than an engineering gap: sampling methods lose influential neighbors while clustering methods lose structural patterns, so each remedy sacrifices part of the signal the model needs.
subjectOf.abstract: Scalability is a major concern for GNNs on large real-world graphs, as sampling methods may lose influential neighbors while clustering methods may lose structural patterns.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607
scope_conditions: large real world graphs where full graph processing is infeasible
